module.name: MiSTer SDRAM XS-DS v2.9 (2021-04-21) / v3.0 (2023-04-03), 'SDRAM board (dual-chip) for MiSTer (extra slim)', Sorgelig
sources: https://misterfpga.org/viewtopic.php?t=3440 (robinsonb5, 2021-10-11: a single select is inverted for one of the two chips)
Alliance Memory AS4C32M16SB datasheet Rev 1.4 June 2024
module.chips: 2 x AS4C32M16SB-6TIN, 8M words x 16 x 4 banks each, row A0-A12, column A0-A9, A10 auto/all-bank precharge, 8192 refresh cycles per 64 ms
module.shared_pins: A0-A12, BA0-1, DQ0-15, CLK, RAS#, CAS#, WE#; DQML tied to A11 and DQMH to A12 on-module; CKE tied to VCC
module.chip_select: header SDRAM_nCS -> U1 CS# directly and -> U3 (LVC1G04 inverter) -> U2 CS#
module.polarity: nCS low = chip 0 (U1, word address bit 23 = 0); nCS high = chip 1 (U2, bit 23 = 1); exactly one chip decodes every clock; NOP = RAS/CAS/WE high at either level; CMD_INHIBIT (CS high, RAS/CAS/WE low) would be LOAD MODE on U2 and is never issued (asserted in simulation)
module.sixty_four_mib_cores: keep nCS low, so U2 is never initialized, refreshed or read (tb_sdram on the stock controller: chip 1 decoded 0 commands)

sdram_xl.address_contract: word address bit 23 = chip, bits 21:9 = row, {bit 22, bits 8:0} = column, bank = SDRAM bank: the lower 23 bits split as the 64 MiB module does

refresh.strategy: jtframe_sdram64_rfsh BOTH: each slot = precharge-all chip 0, precharge-all chip 1, refresh chip 0, refresh chip 1, tRFC wait; RFSHCNT (9 per 64 us line) unchanged per chip
refresh.cost: one clock per slot (11 vs 10 clocks at 96 MHz, chained 9 vs 8): +9 clocks per 6144-clock line, refresh overhead 1.5 % -> 1.6 % of the SDRAM bus
refresh.rejected: doubling RFSHCNT and alternating chips (the burst controller's XL mode): 72-90 extra clocks per line and it still needs the both-chip precharge

sdram_xl.programmer: PRECHARGE_ALL bank keeps the precharged flag per chip: a precharge-all reaches one chip, so the first write to the other chip precharges it before activating (a re-download into a running core can find rows open in both chips)
